title: Robot Loop Pattern Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robotics and Computational Thinking
description: A step-through explorer for MicroPython for loops, while loops, and nested loops. Students predict how many times each loop body runs, then watch a robot blink its NeoPixels or drive toward a wall while a counter tracks every iteration.

educational.topic: for loops, while loops, and nested loops in robot programs
learningObjectives: Predict how many times a for loop body runs for range(n) and the last value of the loop variable.
Predict how many times a while loop runs for a given start distance and step size.
Predict the total iterations of a nested loop as outer times inner.
Choose a for loop or a while loop for a given robot task.
prerequisites: The if statement and indented code blocks
standards: CSTA 2-AP-12: Design and iteratively develop programs that combine control structures, including nested loops and compound conditionals

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict-then-step: students record a prediction, then step through the loop one iteration at a time
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Tabs select the loop type; number inputs set the loop bounds; Step, Run, and Reset control execution while a counter tracks iterations.
keyQuestions: How many times does for i in range(5) run, and what is the last value of i?
Why does the while loop stop when distance_cm reaches 20?
What happens if the loop body never changes distance_cm?
How does adding a nested loop change the total number of iterations?
commonMisconceptions: A while loop with distance_cm > 20 still runs when distance_cm equals 20.
A while loop will stop on its own even if nothing in the body changes the condition.
A nested loop adds the inner and outer counts instead of multiplying them.
assessmentOpportunities: Challenge: predict the total for outer = 4 and inner = 5 (answer: 20).
Challenge: predict the while-loop iterations for start 60 and step 10 (answer: 4).
Exit ticket: choose for or while for three robot tasks and justify the choice.
